scenes.prompt: Create a small decorative editorial watercolor vignette for an Italian university admissions website. Follow the reference image's delicate hand-painted watercolor technique, ochre architecture, natural greens, paper texture in painted strokes and restrained burgundy accents. New composition: one inviting Italian university courtyard arch with a terracotta roof fragment, one slim cypress, and a small burgundy satchel at the base. Imagined architecture, not an identifiable institution. Compact well-defined silhouette, very few objects, readable at 64 pixels and charming at 176 pixels. Natural saturated pigment in key details, do not make the whole illustration faint. Center the vignette and use most of the square with about 8% margin, soft irregular watercolor edges. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no white rectangle, no surrounding ground or paper background, no shadow panel. No people, no words, no logo, no lettering, no border, no interface, no badges, no checkmarks. This is one standalone decorative artwork, not a screenshot.
